items.title: Foreign buyers reach a record share as sales slow
items.summary: Spain’s registrars report that foreign nationals accounted for 16.05% of Q3 home purchases, just over 26,300 registered transactions. Total sales fell 5.9% year on year to 164,148. Málaga province’s average registered price reached €3,400/m². These are completed, registered sales across the wider market, rather than luxury asking prices.
items.figureLabel: Foreign share of Spain’s Q3 home purchases

items.title: Marbella opens consultation on planning changes
items.summary: Public consultation runs from 28 October to 25 November on amendments to Marbella’s 1986 planning rules for productive and tourism uses. The town hall’s package covers 15 rules, including conditional hotel-development flexibility. These remain proposed changes under consultation; the announced aim is entry into force in 2027, subject to the statutory process.
items.status: Public consultation · Proposed rules, not enacted

items.title: Marbella asking prices edge higher in October
items.summary: Idealista’s October data put Marbella’s advertised housing price at €5,974/m², up 0.1% month on month and 3.1% annually. Nagüeles–Golden Mile stood at €8,245/m², down 1.0% over the month. The date marks the reporting month’s end. These are asking-price indicators across listed housing, not completed-sale prices or individual villa valuations.

items.title: Kategora launches Malak’s managed apartments
items.summary: Kategora announced sales of 120 hotel apartments at Malak, a planned €36 million project, with asking prices from €278,000. Kora Living is to operate the complex under a hotel licence, with opening targeted for 2029. The developer’s estimated 6% net return is a projection, not an achieved or guaranteed yield.
items.source: Kategora company release via Europa Press · 29 October 2026

items.title: St. Regis signs for Marbella
items.summary: The 20 October agreement between Sierra Blanca Estates, Platinum Estates and Marriott envisages 169 hotel rooms and 151 luxury residences, with announced investment above €500 million and opening targeted for 2031. At announcement, urbanisation and licensing steps remained pending. Retained after review: the agreement does not establish completed delivery or confirmed residential sale prices.
